name: Baseline V1 (retrieval+rerank identical; LLM substituted gemini-2.5-flash -> gemini-3.6-flash)

deviation.reason: The frozen Baseline V1 LLM 'google/gemini-2.5-flash' returns HTTP 404 'no longer available to new users' on the available Google Gemini API key (2026). Google's named successor 'gemini-3.6-flash' is used instead so answer-quality/latency (Phases 6/12-14) are unblocked.
deviation.unchanged_vs_baseline: parser, chunking (2500/300), embedding (all-MiniLM-L6-v2), vector store (Chroma cosine), retrieval (top_k=20), reranker (Cohere rerank-v3.5, top_n=5). Retrieval + rerank are therefore directly comparable to the Phase 5 dense baseline.
deviation.index_note: Reuses the exact Phase 5 frozen snapshot 'baseline_v1' (RAW chunk text; LLM summaries were unavailable) and the local Chroma collection 'eval_baseline_v1'. content_indexed is honestly recorded as 'raw'. A summary-based index is a separate future experiment (and would need the frozen 2.5-flash for true faithfulness).

parser.granularity: one Document per PDF page; single Document for docx/txt

indexing.content_indexed_note: RAW chunk text (reuses the Phase 5 snapshot; summaries were unavailable when it was frozen). Kept raw so retrieval stays directly comparable to the Phase 5 dense baseline (one-variable rule).

vector_store.experiment_mode: local persistent Chroma, collection eval_baseline_v1 (isolated; reused from Phase 5)

reranker.name: rerank-v3.5
reranker.eval_note: Cohere key is Trial-tier (10 calls/min). The eval harness applies a throttle (EVAL_COHERE_MIN_INTERVAL_MS) + bounded 429 retry so reranked metrics are clean, not degraded fallbacks.
